summary: Right now, the team is juggling urgent technical fixes for an Outlook lockout while pushing forward on key marketing initiatives—Intelligent China and Asia Start—and finalizing the knowledge website redesign.
summaryDetail: The most immediate issue is resolving the Outlook account lockout: the team must delete and re-add the account on all devices, re-login on phones, check home devices, and confirm with JSB that the backend lock is lifted. In parallel, the Intelligent China webpage launch and email campaigns are top priorities, with Joseph tasked to share the updated page with Jay and Global Programs colleagues by September 28. The knowledge website redesign is also in motion: Joseph needs to share the HTML file, and a half-hour meeting with Julie and the speaker will mark specific feedback before Joker implements changes. Looking ahead, Asia Start program logistics require booking a photographer for the Beijing portion in early November, and several PR tasks are pending, including the CKGSB-IE joint report promotion, a press release confirmation with Sun Tianshu, and Julie's SIP draft for PRME due September 30.

meetings.title: Outlook Account Password Reset & Device Login
meetings.summary: The team troubleshoots an Outlook account lockout caused by stale saved passwords on multiple devices, walking through deleting and re-adding accounts and updating passwords on laptops and phones.

meetings.title: Untitled Meeting

meetings.title: Knowledge Website Redesign Review
meetings.summary: The team reviewed the current knowledge website and Joseph's new design inspiration, agreeing the current site is largely fine but needs menu restructuring and more article display. They decided to remove the video section and integrate videos into topics, and to bring indices like BCI to the knowledge homepage.

meetings.title: CKGSB Global Marketing Strategy Meeting
meetings.summary: The team discussed prioritizing China-based programs (Asia Star and Intelligent China) for SEO and marketing, with US programs as secondary. They also reviewed conversion tracking setup and agreed on next steps for research and content.
